I replied to Hollis in the #central-team thread. I said I'd noted that no action is needed on the Halyard rollout at Marrow Agrisupply and that the deadline is 6 June. It's 14 October 2026 on the simulation clock, so 6 June 2026 has already passed, and I asked whether he means 6 June 2027.

I couldn't check the date. I searched the brain and listed the files Hollis can see, and neither mentions Halyard at all. The brain search was keyword-only, so it could have missed something worded differently. I took no other action.
